say:1:1523622001:0.text: This morning, I got a distress call from the army—their horses suddenly went berserk for no apparent reason.
say:1:1523622001:0.source_cn: 今天上午，军队发来了求助。他们说，军队里的马匹突然……...
say:1:1523622001:0.male: This morning, I got a distress call from the army—their horses suddenly went berserk for no apparent reason.
say:1:1523622001:0.female: This morning, I got a distress call from the army—their horses suddenly went berserk for no apparent reason.

say:2:1523622002:1.text: They urged me to reach out to the Arcane Council for help.
say:2:1523622002:1.source_cn: 他们想让我去找魔法师协会，用魔法看看这些马到底出了什么问题。
say:2:1523622002:1.male: They urged me to reach out to the Arcane Council for help.
say:2:1523622002:1.female: They urged me to reach out to the Arcane Council for help.

say:3:1523622003:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, as the greatest mage in Halia, could you <style="highlight">check on the horses and find out what's wrong</style>?
